P3HT thin-film transducers are highly sensitive and selective for detection of gaseous compounds in the ppb range.
P3HT TFT devices are promising for gas sensing applications due to their high sensitivity and low cost.
P3HT TFT sensors are able to detect analytes in concentrations down to units of ppb, and they are more sensitive than any chemical sensors addressed herein.

a new approach of using P3HT TFT as a gas sensor.

the development of a new class of sensors for disease diagnosis and environment control, which are based on organic semiconductors and are capable to detect low concentrations of volatile organic compounds.
the development of a novel gas sensor based on organic thin film transistors (TFTs).

P3HT transconductance is a reliable and robust parameter to detect and monitor gaseous analyte concentrations.

P3HT TFT-based sensors could be used in the detection of low concentrations of analytes, which are of great interest for disease diagnosis and environment control, and thus, could be used as a complementary technology to chemical sensors.
